passives.name: I Can Sleep Soon
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken effect to all allies for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). Increases Speed proportional to the caster's missing Health. When hit, if inflicted with Bleeding, increases damage taken. After attacking, grants increased Defense to all allies for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000054_4_3] turn(s). At the end of the caster's turn, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000025_4_2]. Every turn, increases Attack of the caster by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]. (Max 20 stacks)
